name: Enchanting
title: Six-step modifier manipulation profession
summary: Enchanting progresses through random modifier addition; full reforge; permanent locking; one-time extraction/insertion; raising one modifier's tier; and changing numeric values on unlocked modifiers. Type weights stay fixed per base; thresholds, ingredients, costs, time, and some operation scopes remain open.
scenarioNote: One extracted modifier is a single-use instance; extraction destroys its source item.

points.text: Six operations unlock in sequence from learning the profession; exact skill levels remain open.
Full reforge regenerates all unlocked modifiers while preserving count and group distribution; locked modifiers stay unchanged.
Locks are permanent; successive locks cost more; inserted modifiers are locked.
Extraction preserves identity, tier, and group but not numeric value, destroys the source item, and allows one insertion into a matching free group slot.
No separate delete or replace operation exists.

gaps: Unlock thresholds, costs/ingredients/time, random-add group choice, base compatibility, tier-improvement eligibility, and numeric target scope.
